column1: # Game profile of Mario Strikers: Battle League (Switch, update 1.3.2 = v393216). Plays on the Mac: its menus and exhibition matches
# Next Level Games' engine, SDK 13.3.0, with Havok, Wwise and NEX / Pia. Everything but the Wwise banks is in the engine's own archives, version 4 of the format Luigi's Mansion 3 uses
# (<name>.dict indexes zstd chunks in <name>.data; update 1.3.2 adds <name>.patch, version 5): shader_split.py nlg4_shaders reads 3,149 shaders from init and the 41 of the UI layouts'
# BNSH files (global, FrontEnd/Persistent, ClubStadium/Tutorial_TutorialCommon); main holds 40 more (3,230 in all)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie, the intro's VP9 movies)
# The NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true: nninitStartup (main+0x620420) gives StandardAllocator 10 GB of address space, cut to 3 GB in patches.py,
# beside the node area and 1 GB alignment cuts of this sdk build (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py). The 5 GB block of Engage: 256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + the heap region.
# About 2.0 GB resident in the menus, 2.5 to 2.8 GB in a match
# the game sets the near = 0 depth mode (log: depth mode: near=0, vertex shaders use the main0_z entry), for the pipeline bases made before it runs
# the survey's groups by RomFS folder; the shaders come from init.dict and global.dict (the root, so "other") and main
